subject: MAP: Onramp playbook and limited-use dataset access for Acme Retail evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Onramp playbook and limited-use dataset access for Acme Retail evaluation

Michael —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discussion, attaching a compact mutual action plan (MAP) and the proposed onramp milestones so we can align on timing and the dataset exchange constraints. High level plan:

- Week 0 (Dec 7): Legal + security handshake (short MSA appendix + usage covenant)
- Week 1 (Dec 14): Technical onboarding & sandbox creds
- Week 2–3 (Dec 15–28): Evaluation window (ephemeral dataset access; token-limited)
- Week 4 (Jan 4): Close decision and contract finalization / procurement steps

Key usage constraints we need on record from Acme: 1) datasets are for evaluation only (no redistribution), 2) retention max 90 days in ephemeral sandbox unless extended, 3) access limited to named engineers and IP ranges, 4) audit log requirement (we provide). We will provide an export manifest and a tiny sample CSV so your team can validate ingestion.

Attachments: redwood-map-onramp-v1.pdf (MAP + milestones), eval-dataset-manifest.csv (file list + provenance), access-lane-instructions.txt (how to connect to ephemeral sandbox).

Next steps we suggest: if the MAP is acceptable, sign the appendix (simple reply-to-approve) and we will provision an ephemeral token lane and a time-boxed dataset snapshot. I’m happy to host a short 30-minute technical kickoff tomorrow or Wednesday.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

----
Note: attachments referenced above are stubs.
From: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@acmeretail.com>, procure@acmeretail.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Onramp playbook and limited-use dataset access for Acme Retail evaluation

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear plan. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Procurement will need an estimated cost delta for a 4-week evaluation (even if covered by credits) to create a short PO. Can you add line items (sandbox hours, support, any transfer fees)?
- Security asked for the exact retention enforcement mechanism — do you auto-delete, or do we get a deletion certificate?
- We can provision named users; recommended contact list: myself and Elena Park (analytics lead) + two engineers (I’ll send names after the kickoff).

Tech kickoff Wednesday works for us (Dec 8) at 10:00am PT. Please send the calendar invite. If procurement needs language in the MAP, loop me and I’ll expedite.

Thanks — look forward to the trial.
Michael
Director, Data & Analytics | Acme Retail
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Onramp playbook and limited-use dataset access for Acme Retail evaluation

Jordan / Michael —

Quick answers to the security & procurement questions so we can keep the timeline:

- Cost: for the 4-week window we’ll provide a sponsor credit of up to $3,500 for hosted sandbox usage; any overage billed at standard sandbox hourly rates. I’ll attach a short line-item estimate in the drive link (see related_links).
- Retention & deletion: we enforce automated deletion of the ephemeral dataset snapshot 90 days from provisioning. For this trial we set the lane to auto-delete 28 days after the snapshot is created. We will also provide a signed deletion certificate (PDF) upon removal.
- Audit logs: per-token and per-IP logs are available and we can provide a weekly export into your S3 or a secure Drive link.
- Access lanes: we will whitelist IP ranges and accept named user requests; keys expire at the end of the evaluation window.

Attached: brief checklist and the dataset manifest you can share with security. Ben — can you please prepare the two-line PO-friendly summary for procurement and drop it into the HubSpot deal?

Grace O'Connor
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: access-lane-instructions.txt (connect steps), eval-dataset-manifest.csv (file inventory).
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Onramp playbook and limited-use dataset access for Acme Retail evaluation

Michael / Elena —

Perfect — invite sent for Wed 12/8 10:00 PT. Agenda: quick intro, security checklist walk, dataset manifest review, and provisioning timeline (15/16th for snapshot).

Ben has populated the two-line spend note in the HubSpot deal (link above). Michael: if procurement wants a named-signature approval for the MAP appendix, reply-all with the approval text and we’ll consider that signature-for-provisioning. Example approval text: "Acme Retail approves the Redwood Evaluation MAP v1 and accepts the limited-use dataset terms for the trial (PO to follow)."

We’ll plan to provision an ephemeral lane on Dec 15 and share temporary creds valid through Jan 12 (28 days). Any objections to that cadence?

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Jordan

--
